title: RT.INT.TR.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 123 (T(AF)M-27). RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) is the subject; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: PROJ-DYM (projectional dynamics), PRI-VT-TD (principle vibrational tendencies) and T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From PRI-VT-TD: RE-DIFF. From T-C-IMP: TR-INFO (trans-information) and TRS (transition). From TRS: AFTD (affinity tendencies). From AFTD: S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation).
